defects.name: Footnotes flattened into body paragraphs
defects.origin: PDF reconstruction/model-to-DOCX serialization, compounded by canonical extraction
defects.cat_effect: Studio receives ordinary body trans-units, not anchored footnote content.

defects.name: Recital markers detached from recital bodies
defects.origin: PDF structural classification and typed-model hierarchy
defects.cat_effect: Each marker is an independent TU; numbering can detach visually and contextually from its recital.

defects.name: Running headers, language labels and page furniture modeled as body content
defects.origin: PDF layout classification and frozen DOCX serializer

evidence.other_furniture: dates, OJ title and L 376/page identifiers are also body TUs

defects.cat_effect: Furniture consumes translation units, can remain English, and cannot repeat through real Word headers.

defects.name: Layout fidelity is structural but not typographic/paginated

evidence.serializer_behavior: new blank Document, Heading 2/body paragraphs, Table Grid

defects.cat_effect: Text order is stable, but page composition, two-column OJ layout and repeating furniture are not preserved.

defects.name: Tables retain logical cells but lose source table geometry/style
defects.cat_effect: Cell identity survives, but widths, borders, alignment, spacing and continuation semantics are not fidelity-controlled.

defects.name: Macedonian legal terminology is inconsistent
defects.origin: Translation generation/context retrieval and terminology QA
defects.cat_effect: Source mapping is correct, but no approved-term constraint enforces one institutional equivalent.

stage_assessment.pdf_extraction: Text and provenance are complete, but furniture/recital/footnote relationships are incompletely classified.
stage_assessment.typed_reconstruction: Tables are strong; footnote body classification is inconsistent and anchors/recital containers/furniture roles are absent.
stage_assessment.validated_docx: First irreversible flattening point for footnotes, recital hierarchy, furniture and page layout.
stage_assessment.canonical_model: Faithfully extracts the already-flattened DOCX; schema cannot represent footnote anchors, recital associations or furniture roles.
stage_assessment.translation: Introduces terminology inconsistency and leaves two EN furniture labels untranslated.
stage_assessment.cat_projection: Preserves the canonical error model; it is not the origin of the structural losses.
stage_assessment.mk1_reconstruction: Preserves source DOCX structure exactly, so it cannot restore structures absent from the validated DOCX.
